entries.title: Psalms 114:1
segments: ¶When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language,

entries.title: Psalms 114:2
segments: Judah was his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

entries.title: Psalms 114:3
segments: The sea saw it and fled, the Jordan turned back;

entries.title: Psalms 114:4
segments: The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.

entries.title: Psalms 114:5
segments: What ailed thee, thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou turnedst back?

entries.title: Psalms 114:6
segments: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams? ye hills, like lambs?

entries.title: Psalms 114:7
segments: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the +God of Jacob,

entries.title: Psalms 114:8
segments: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
